name: Feature request
about: A new behaviour for the app or a new prompt experiment

---

**Problem.** The need this solves, for a student cooking on a budget.

**Proposal.** What we would build, in one or two sentences.

**AI or code?** Does this touch the prompt/model, the Python maths, the web page, or the data? (Remember: the model never touches the money.)

**Done when.** How we will know it works (a test, a case in tests/prompt_cases.json, a visible result).
